scope: B02 reflected view, Bearish wrappers and public candidate geometry, RE19–RE30, lines 690–885; local only
provenance: Separate same-assistant source-first pass. Direct source contracts before comparison; no independently staffed or blind audit, runtime or accepted cross-owner gate.

groups.interpretation: View retains original source strongly and creates a fixed-size list of null cache slots using initial len(source); no mutation detection, resize or invalidation.
Length queries use current source length rather than initial cache length.

Slice recognized with isinstance; normalize against current source length, expand range in requested order including negative step; materialize list by repeated scalar lookup. Invalid slice or later lookup propagates; earlier cache fills are not rolled back.

Scalar indexes cache first using native list semantics; on null only, reflect source[index], then store and return exact slot object. Negative indexes refer to cache size first; changed source can be stale, mismatched or out of bounds. No local refresh.
Process-local reflected cache retains pairs of source and view; id keys do not mean content equality.
Compute identity key, read cache; nonnull cached pair must also have source object identity; hit returns exact view, not a fresh one.
On miss allocate view first, publish pair then return view; allocation failure occurs before registration. No local eviction or freshness check.
Bearish adapter first initializes base with original sequences and then creates Bullish reference with original sequences; inherited registries may already have side effects.
Replace reference main view, lower view, then lower index with reflected adapter over original lower index. Time arrays remain original. No local rollback if later step fails.
Forward positional argument unchanged, sign-copy returned value, mirror returned source into new candle; equal physical fields do not imply original object identity.
Mirror candidate and candle, call reference breakout analysis, mirror returned analysis; nullable helper does not independently validate delegate input.
Mirror candidate and candle before reference invalidation call; return delegate result directly; caller admission not rechecked.
Mirror candidate, candle and confirmed top by exact sign-copy before reference reset admission; no additional main-breach test.
Eagerly mirror analysis, sign-copy top, mirror candle before delegate invocation, including null analysis case. No wrapper shortcut or exception recovery.
Mirror nonnull returned source into new candle, otherwise return null.
Call reference detect with same first_only; construct bearish result.
Mirror reactions in order, shallow replace each reset with only broken_level sign-copied; preserve start/end and list order. New lists; no owner renumbering.
Read chronology main/lower sequences before shallow cloning candidate, even if Break missing. Access/copy failures propagate. Geometry freeze is conditional, not universal.
Null break returns clone before integer conversion or direction validation.
Convert First then Break to int; short-circuit negative First, reversed Break or Break outside full main list; invalid bounds return clone. First==Break allowed; malformed conversion can raise.
Read Break row and timeframe before direction dispatch.
Exact bullish branch; integer bottom source must equal positional Break to enter clipping, else unchanged clone.

Seed full First low and owner row, scan [First+1,Break) strictly decreasing lows; equality keeps earliest selected owner. Threshold is existing box top. First==Break seeds full Break, even if extreme later than confirmation.
Exact bearish branch mirrors: integer top source must equal Break; seed First high and scan strictly greater highs over same interval. Threshold existing box bottom. Same-main caveat preserved.
Unsupported direction raises only after valid converted bounds and chronology attributes were accessed.
Request lower_bounds over Break open to open+timeframe; no intrabar_start restriction. Native bisect boundary is start inclusive/end exclusive on ordered times. No completeness check.

Iterate lower slice in native order. Bullish strictly lower low updates value and assigns Break main source first; then strict high > threshold confirms and breaks. Same-row opposite extreme allowed; equality neither updates nor confirms.
Bearish strict high update precedes strict low < threshold confirmation, same order and Break main provenance; no inference of within-row sequencing.
No confirming lower record, including empty slice, returns original shallow clone even if local candidate extreme changed.

On confirmation mutate only opposite price/source index/source display time on clone; source stored index/time (not lower event or loop index). Return clone; original detection not mutated, no ledger or visibility reclassification.

supplemental.historical: Reflected view retains original source; cache allocated to initial length. __len__ returns current source length, not cache size. No automatic resize or invalidation; same-position source mutation not detected. Slice normalized with current length, scalar native list indexing; cache miss creates mirror and stores it.
Identity-key lookup requires same source object; new view stores source and cache. No freshness check or automatic invalidation.
Bearish base and reference initialize on original data before replacing reference sequences and lower index; main and lower timestamps remain original. No alternate independent bearish state machine.

All wrapper calls preserve temporal positions and order; use explicit sign-copy and role reflection. Detection returns mirrored candidates and reset copies with broken level only changed; retains original bounds and list order.

Read chronology arrays before candidate clone; missing Break returns clone before direction validation. Integer conversions occur First then Break. Negative First, reversed geometry or Break outside full array returns unchanged. First==Break is accepted.

If Break owns opposite edge, initialize from full First candle then scan complete main candles First+1..Break exclusive. With First==Break, initialization includes full Break candle; no separate same-main correction. Unsupported direction raises only after valid bounds.

Use full Break lower interval, not intrabar_start. Scan source order, update strict opposite edge before strict confirmation; same-row eligible, later rows ignored. If no confirmation, clone unchanged. Lower extremes attributed to Break main; equality preserves earlier selected source. No mutation of native candidate.

decision_order: fixed slot allocation versus dynamic source length
original base and reference initialization before three swaps
eager wrapper argument reflection before delegate
nullable Break then integer bounds then direction
Break-owned opposite extreme then full main seed
full lower slice update before strict confirmation
limitations: Native sequence and timestamp alignment conditional; custom types may dispatch differently. No empirical cache invalidation or runtime safety claim.
Bounded consumer trace does not close CP354-F03 or CP355-F02, or global W3.

findings.meaning: Clarify RE19–RE30 native indexing/failure order, exact identity retention, eager nullable mirror inputs, clone read/validation order and conditional projection provenance. Retain historical B02-03-F01 and F02; no production defect asserted.
